opening.argument: The speaker asks viewers to deposit Bitcoin into Mirror Trading International and ties earnings to recruiting people into left and right legs of a binary team. Qualification requires a direct referral on each side, and recruits who pay are promised placement beneath viewers to generate commissions. The pitch combines a $100 minimum contribution and funding within seven days with pressure to join while incoming members can still be placed underneath them. It reinforces that inducement with claims of substantial earnings and Bitcoin income every day. These features establish a recruitment-driven scam pitch: viewers are encouraged to join and fund the platform through downline commissions and continuous-income claims, without evidence here of actual losses or realized returns.
